alerts.text: High surf advisory until Sun 10 am. Large breaking waves of 5 to 7 feet with sets 8 to 10 feet along west-facing beaches.

High surf advisory until Tue 3 pm. Large breaking waves of 8 to 14 feet, peaking Saturday. Surf may locally reach 15 feet near Ventura Harbor, where surf will likely be the largest. Dangerous rip currents expected.
Small craft advisory until Sun 3 am. Hazardous sea conditions.
Small craft advisory until Wed 3 am. Hazardous sea conditions.
Coastal flood advisory until Sat 6 pm. Large breaking waves will run up beaches and crash over seawalls, inundating adjacent, low-lying infrastructure.
High surf warning until Sun 4 am. Dangerously large breaking waves of 25 to 35 ft, with occasional sets of 40 to 50 ft at favored breakpoints.

Hazardous seas warning until Mon 3 pm. Very steep and hazardous seas 19 to 24 feet and south winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 35 kt.
